provider: CUHK Department of Translation 2025-26-and-thereafter Major Programme Requirement and current Course List
academicYear: Applicable to students admitted in 2025-26 and thereafter
note: The official Department page publishes a 66-unit Translation Major for students admitted in 2025-26 and thereafter: 9 units of Faculty Package courses, four fixed Required Courses, any two of three Capstone courses, and 39 units of Major Electives including at least one course from each of Cluster A and Cluster B. The 2026-27 official admissions leaflet independently confirms the 66-unit structure and recommended four-year course pattern. This supplement exposes all 41 current departmental courses named by the 2025-26-and-thereafter Major requirement: four fixed Required Courses, three Capstone options and 34 Major Electives. It does not import the cross-department Faculty Package pool because the Translation Department page publishes the codes but not the complete current titles and applicability details for those external courses; TRAN1000 is explicitly inapplicable to Translation Major students. TRAN4120 is excluded because the current official Course List marks it cancelled effective from 2023-24. TRAN4050 and TRAN4840 are excluded because their rows are commented out and they do not appear in the 2025-26-and-thereafter requirement. The list is intentionally browse-only and must not be presented as a complete 66-unit graduation audit.
